articles.title: Lifecycle hooks in v1.31: rules that fire every time, for free
articles.focus: How Nanocoder v1.31 introduces hooks at six lifecycle points (session-start, session-end, user-prompt-submit, pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, pre-compact), why they are the right tool for enforceable rules instead of skill subscriptions, and how pre-tool-use can veto a tool call before any approval prompt appears.

articles.title: Architect mode: review the turn, not the edit
articles.focus: How v1.31 new Architect mode replaces per-file approvals with a per-turn checkpoint taken at the first file mutation, with a one-keypress undo at the end that lets you judge the finished result and roll it back wholesale instead of approving each edit on the way.

articles.title: The Nanocoder VS Code extension, rebuilt as a native sidebar chat
articles.focus: How the v1.31 extension moved from an opt-in WebSocket companion over a terminal session to a native sidebar chat driven by the Agent Client Protocol, with collapsible per-turn work summaries, file-change chips, code lenses, and live subagent progress streamed straight into the editor.
